'''Gredan Obsnog''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader for the [[Tonvarr pirates]] who was stationed to guard [[Fort Tonvarr]] alongside [[Yosh Woon]] and [[Elu Neleh]]. Eventually he was killed alongside other Tonvarr pirates.<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|The Fall of Fort Tonvarr|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>
